name: chathelp-business-app
description: ChatHelp Business – native Android-/iOS-App (Capacitor 8). Hülle um https://chat-help.com/chat/app.php mit nativen Push-Benachrichtigungen (FCM/APNs), Haptik, Splash und Statusleiste.

scripts.sync:android: npm run www && cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android.js
scripts.sync:ios: npm run www && cap sync ios && node scripts/patch-ios.js
scripts.check: node --check scripts/build-www.js && node --check scripts/setup-platform.js && node --check scripts/patch-android.js && node --check scripts/patch-ios.js && node --check scripts/assets.js && node scripts/build-www.js --check
